admission.justification: Prevents moving tool dispatch onto provisional SDK middleware or losing 1.x ToolError wire texts that agents act on, guarded by wire-parity, concurrency, and stdio tests.

applicability: Every tool invocation dispatched through AgentsRememberMCP constructed by create_server.
conditions: AgentsRememberMCP subclasses MCPServer and overrides the public 3-argument call_tool(name, arguments, context) method without provisional call middleware.

Synchronous handlers offload via thread_workers with write-lock FIFO ordering, deferred start_after_discovery, request/definition/heap-trim scopes, and UnexpectedToolError mapped to ToolError carrying the cause message.
exclusions: Handshake-only initialize middleware preserve_handshake_extensions, which never intercepts tool calls.
Private SDK attribute retirements deferred to 261125-DEP-L4.
statement: AgentsRememberMCP subclasses MCPServer, overrides the public 3-argument call_tool(name, arguments, context) method without provisional call middleware, preserves thread_workers offload, write-lock FIFO ordering, deferred post-discovery start, request/definition/heap-trim scopes, and maps UnexpectedToolError back to exact 1.x ToolError wire text.
title: MCPServer public call_tool preserves offload, lock, scopes, and ToolError text
